articles.headline: Chandrayaan-3: a milestone on the Moon
articles.summary: India’s Chandrayaan-3 achieved a soft landing on the Moon on 23 August 2023. Revisit the mission and the science behind it.
body: The mission demonstrated safe soft landing, rover movement and in-situ scientific experiments.
Vikram was the lander and Pragyan the rover. The landing was in the Moon’s southern high-latitude region, not at the geographic south pole.

articles.headline: Railway electrification: understand the power behind the journey
articles.summary: A static-GK demonstration explainer on electric traction, overhead lines and the role of transformers.
body: In a common 25 kV AC traction system, overhead equipment supplies electrical energy to the locomotive through a pantograph.
A transformer changes AC voltage levels. Electric traction uses power electronics and motors to turn electrical energy into motion.
facts: Pantograph: collects power from overhead equipment

articles.headline: From analogue to digital: the sampling rule
articles.summary: A technical revision for RRB JE: connect sampling, bandwidth and aliasing with everyday digital electronics.
body: For an ideally band-limited baseband signal with highest frequency B, the sampling rate must exceed 2B to avoid spectral overlap in general.
A practical system uses an anti-aliasing filter before sampling and allows a transition band. Exactly 2B is a theoretical boundary, not a robust practical design choice.
facts: Aliasing: different frequencies become indistinguishable after sampling
staticGK: An ADC converts analogue input into digital codes

articles.headline: Optical fibre: how light carries information
articles.summary: Connect total internal reflection with optical communication and the core-cladding structure.
body: In the ray model, light is guided through an optical fibre by total internal reflection. The core has a higher refractive index than the cladding.
Total internal reflection requires travel from an optically denser to a rarer medium and an incidence angle above the critical angle.
facts: Core refractive index exceeds cladding index
staticGK: Frequency remains unchanged when light crosses a stationary interface
articles.remember: Higher-index core keeps the light guided.
